CHAPTER.CAPTION: Psalm of David
CHAPTER.VERS: O Jehovah, our Lord, how excellent is your majestic name in all the earth! You have displayed your glory above the heavens.
From the mouths of little children and infants, you have built a fortress against your opponents to silence the enemy and the avenger.
When I look at your heavens, the creation of your fingers, the moon and the stars that you have set in place,
what is man that you remember him or the son of man that you take care of him?

You made him a little lower than god-like ones
. You crowned him with glory and honor. (John 1:18)
You made him rule what your hands created. You have put everything under his control:
all the sheep and cattle, the wild animals,
the birds, the fish, whatever swims in the currents of the seas.
O Jehovah, our Lord, how excellent is your majestic name in all the earth!
